name: Tortilla con Cebolla
description: Spanish Tortilla with juicy caramelized onions.
hints: Fry onions in the small pan while potatoes cook in the big pan.
cooklang:
Peel the @potatoes{4%pcs}.
Wash the @potatoes.
Slice the @potatoes.
Peel the @onions{1%pcs}.
Wash the @onions.
Dice the @onions.
Heat the @oil{100%ml}.
Fry the @potatoes in the big pan until tender.
In the small pan cook the garlic and onions until golden.
Beat the @eggs{6%pcs}.
Add @salt{1%tsp} and @pepper{1%pinch}.
Mix the fried potatoes and onions with the beaten eggs, salt and pepper.
Pour the mixture into the pan.
Cook for 5 minutes.
With a soft spatula, make sure the tortilla does not stick to the pan.
Flip the tortilla.
Cook for another 5 minutes.
Serve the tortilla.
Celebrate.

steps.instruction: Peel the potatoes cleanly at the board using the peeler.
Slice potatoes into even slices with the chef knife!
Peel the onions carefully at the board.
Dice the onions into small pieces on the board.
Heat oil in the big pan on burner 1.
In the big pan, fry potatoes until tender and golden!
In the small pan on burner 2, fry onions until sweet and caramelized!
At the bowl, whisk eggs until fluffy.
Combine potatoes and caramelized onions with beaten eggs!
Pour mixture into the big pan and cook until set!
Flip with confidence using your spatula!
